inputs.original_text: Phoenix city leaders are taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement. The city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports.
inputs.modified_text: These Phoenix city leaders are at it again, pushing their schemes to undermine federal immigration enforcement and national authority. The city council voted Wednesday night to impose fresh restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement when it comes to using city property. This is the same resistance we've seen before, where these officials put open borders ahead of the rule of law and the protection of American families. Tying the hands of federal agents like this is just asking for more chaos at the border and weakens our fundamental responsibility to safeguard our sovereignty and cultural heritage. It's a glaring example of skewed priorities that favor activist posturing over maintaining traditional order.
